crossRefs.note: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

translations.web: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.
translations.bsb: They crouch down and bring forth their young; they deliver their newborn.
translations.kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
translations.asv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young, They cast out their pains.
